run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T23:00:16Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for frontend coincides with the ad service pod becoming unavailable and staying down. Frontend's own error spans were zero from the start of sample coverage (22:35:16) until the 5-minute rate window ending 23:00:16, then rose: the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds first reported STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 23:00:16 (0.122/s) and reached 0.9/s, and GET /api/data plus 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' errors first appeared at 23:01:16 and peaked at 0.9/s — the per-timestamp values of the /api/data error series equal the GetAds client error series. At the same time the ad service's server-side oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span rate fell from ~0.71-0.85/s to 0.27/s at 23:02:16 and to 0/s from 23:04:16 onward, i.e. ad stopped receiving/serving the calls, so the failures are on the frontend->ad call path, not ad-side error responses. The ad pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owner ReplicaSet ad-554b849958, Deployment ad with replicas: 1, container memory limit 450Mi) shows restartCount 4, last termination OOMKilled exitCode 137 at 23:01:30, current container state terminated OOMKilled exitCode 137 at 23:02:32, ready false (ContainersNotReady since 23:02:33), and 23 BackOff Warning events between 22:59:30 and 23:07:09. Chaos Mesh records a Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh) that spawned StressChaos objects roughly every minute from 22:58:21 to 23:06:06, each reporting 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' (memory stress on exactly this ad container), matching the OOM kills and the error onset. Because the memory stressor's size/selector could not be read from the CRD objects themselves, the causal claim is stated as a hypothesis, so the conclusion is partial; the flagd fault flags that could also fail ads are all defaultVariant 'off', which is counter-evidence to a flag-driven fault.

claims.text: Frontend error spans were zero across all its operations from the first sample at 22:35:16 through the 5-minute rate window ending 22:59:16; the first nonzero frontend error signal is the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds STATUS_CODE_ERROR at 0.1222/s in the window ending 23:00:16, rising to 0.563/s (23:02:16), 0.837/s (23:04:16), 0.9/s (23:08:16) and 0.175/s (23:12:16).

The frontend error spans are confined to specific operations: GET (server), GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds; e.g. GET /api/data STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 0 at 22:59:16 then 0.3296 (23:01:16), 0.7407, 0.8556, 0.9 (23:07:16), 0.8296, 0.3877 — identical at each timestamp to the GetAds client error series (0.9/s at 23:08:16 in the GetAds series).

Frontend also emitted a small volume of tcp.connect STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans that were absent before the deviation (0.0407/s at 23:01:16, 0.0481/s at 23:03:16, 0.0148/s at 23:05:16-23:09:16), consistent with failed outbound connections from the frontend.

The ad service's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds ran at 0.7259-0.8519/s from 22:50:16 to 22:59:16 and 0.7148/s at 23:00:16, then dropped to 0.2704/s at 23:02:16 and to 0/s at 23:04:16 and every point after (23:06:16-23:12:16): requests stopped reaching/served by ad while frontend's calls to it were erroring.

Pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in namespace otel-demo has restartCount 4, lastState terminated reason OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 2026-11-16T23:01:30Z, and current container state terminated reason OOMKilled exitCode 137 finishedAt 2026-11-16T23:02:32Z with ready=false, started=false; the pod's Ready and ContainersReady conditions are False ('containers with unready status: [ad]') since 23:02:33.

Pod events for ad-554b849958-l9ft5 in otel-demo record 23 BackOff Warning events ('Back-off restarting failed container ad') from 22:59:30Z to 23:07:09Z, alongside 6 Pulled/Created/Started Normal events whose last occurrence is 23:04:01Z.

Chaos Mesh StressChaos event messages show memory-stress chaos applied to exactly this container: 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' on otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq (22:58:21Z), -7n9mk (22:59:21Z), -8b272 (23:00:21Z), -sh425 (23:01:21Z), -w8tqb (23:02:22Z) and -w98sl (23:05:11Z), each followed later by TimeUp/Recovered ('Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad'); later attempts -w4ct8 (23:03:21Z) and -9ncrx (23:06:06Z) failed with 'no running task found'.

The chaos objects are produced by Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh: its events show Spawned (Create new object: otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-<suffix>) at 22:58:21, 22:59:21, 23:00:21, 23:01:21, 23:02:21, 23:03:21, 23:05:11 and 23:06:06, and Forbid warnings ('still running') at 23:04:21, 23:05:21, 23:06:06, 23:06:21 and 23:06:34.

Deployment ad in namespace otel-demo has replicas: 1 and a single container 'ad' (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad) with resources limits memory 450Mi / cpu 50m and requests memory 225Mi / cpu 10m, so a single OOM-killed ad pod leaves no serving replica.

frontend-proxy error spans in the same window are on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' and rise with the frontend errors: 0.0037-0.0111/s through 22:59:16, then 0.3556/s (23:01:16), 0.8556/s (23:05:16), 0.9/s (23:07:16) and 0.8296/s (23:09:16).

Only the ad pod shows repeated container restarts in otel-demo: every other listed pod (including frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx, cart-755465879b-rb2h2, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9b7d9, payment-55766d76b9-ckxfk, product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-lszjm, recommendation-5f45f75855-j2fxr, frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-xfrh6) is Running, ready, with restartCount 0.

AccountiTng, payment, cart, checkout, currency, email, shipping, product-catalog, quote, image-provider and frontend-proxy show no ad-path error increase from the ad-specific operations; the service-level STATüsse_CODE_ERROR series that were nonzero before the deviation (ad, fraud-detection, recommendation, frontend-proxy) stayed at their pre-existing small values (e.g. ad 0.0037/s) across 22:35:16-23:00:16, whereas frontend's error series jumped from 0 to 1.359/s at 23:01:16 and 3.614/s at 23:07:16.

Traces returned for ad in the authorized window show healthy behavior on the ad call path before the deviation: oteldemo.AdService/GetAds spans with rpc.grpc.status_code="0" (0.854-1.504 ms) and frontend GET /api/data and frontend-proxy ingress spans with http.status_code="200", with the newest returned trace starting at 22:50:26.799Z.

Most likely root cause: the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh) repeatedly injected memory stress into container ad of pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 from 22:58:21 onward; the container was OOMKilled (exitCode 137) four times and ended terminated/not ready at 23:02:32, the single ad replica stopped serving GetAds (server span rate 0/s from 23:04:16), and frontend's AdService/GetAds client calls errored, surfacing as GET /api/data and server-span failures that produced the RequestErrorRate alert on frontend.

A second, unresolved contributor to the duration of the impact: the ad container has stayed in state terminated (OOMKilled at 23:02:32) with ready=false and no new Started event after 23:04:01, so ad was still unavailable at 23:17 even though the last successful chaos recovery was at 23:06:06; frontend errors were still 0.628/s at 23:10:16 and 0.175/s at 23:12:16. The reason the container did not restart is not visible in the collected evidence.

The flagd fault-injection flags that could break the same ad path are configured off: in ConfigMap flagd-config (otel-demo, key demo.flagd.json) the flags adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure, kafkaQueueProblems, imageSlowLoad, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage and emailMemoryLeak all have defaultVariant "off" (state ENABLED).

Rejected: a fault inside the frontend itself. The frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running, ready, with restartCount 0, and the failing frontend operations are precisely the ones that call AdService (GET /api/data, executing api route (pages) /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds), whose error rate equals the failed GetAds call rate rather than showing independent frontend-internal failures.

Rejected: ad returning application errors. The ad service's own error series stayed at its pre-existing 0.0037/s level through 23:07:16 and its GetAds server span rate fell to 0 rather than turning into error spans, so the failures are failed/absent calls to ad, not ad-side error responses.

Inspect the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and its spawned StressChaos objects with kubectl (chaos-mesh CRDs are not readable through the authorized tool set) to confirm the memory stressor size, target selector and duration, and suspend the Schedule if the ad pod is not meant to be stress-tested; then confirm the ad Deployment reaches a ready replica again and frontend's GetAds error rate returns to zero.

gaps: The Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and the StressChaos objects could not be read: chaos-mesh CRD kinds are not in the allowed resource list and querying 'stresschaos' was refused with INVALID_PARAMS, so the stressor type/size, target selector and duration are known only from event messages and object names.

Jaeger returned no traces for the incident window: traces_search for frontend (22:55:16-23:17:31) and traces_search_by_tags with error=true returned no spans, and the newest ad trace shown starts at 22:50:26.799Z, so trace-level error tags (gRPC status codes, error details) for the failing calls are unknown.

Container logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx and ad-554b849958-l9ft5 returned no lines for the incident window (0 bytes read; previous ad instance unavailable), so no application error text or OOM-side log evidence is available.
kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready has no series in this Prometheus for the queried window, so ad Deployment ready-replica history is unknown; pod-level status was used instead.

The alert definition itself could not be verified: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no data, so the rule expression and the reported value 2.6222 could not be reproduced.
The reason the ad container did not restart after terminating at 23:02:32Z (no Started event after 23:04:01Z, ready=false at 23:17) is not visible in the collected evidence.
The change_history integration is not integrated, so any configuration or schedule change history around 22:58 is unavailable.
next_steps: Read the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress spec and its StressChaos children with kubectl -n chaos-mesh to confirm stressors.memory size, mode/selector and duration, and whether the Schedule is still active.

Check the ad pod's kubelet-side restart behavior (container state terminated since 23:02:32Z, BackOff events ending 23:07:09Z) to determine why the container has not been restarted and whether the chaos daemon is still attached.
Re-check frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error rate and ad pod readiness after the ad Deployment is healthy again, to confirm the error-rate alert clears with ad availability.
Retrieve the RequestErrorRate rule expression and threshold from the alerting configuration to reproduce the reported 2.6222 value.
